"""Boundary shapes: forest-0-only FIBs, max fanout, deep chains, odd cell counts."""
import json, subprocess, sys, random, collections
sys.path.insert(0, '/workspace/tmp/tests')
from ref import Image, Fib, Bad

def run(ops, addrs=(['%032x' % 0], ['%032x' % 0])):
    body = json.dumps({"cases": [{"ops": ops}]}, separators=(',', ':'))
    p = subprocess.run([sys.executable, 'run.py'], input=body.encode(), cwd='/workspace',
                       capture_output=True, timeout=300)
    if p.returncode != 0:
        raise SystemExit('rc %d %s' % (p.returncode, p.stderr.decode()[:400]))
    return json.loads(p.stdout.decode())['results'][0]

def check(ops, addrs_q, addrs_i, label):
    res = run(ops + [['query', addrs_q], ['image_query', addrs_i]])
    fib = Fib(); exp = []
    loaded = None
    for op in ops + [['query', addrs_q], ['image_query', addrs_i]]:
        if op[0] == 'put': fib.put(op[1], op[2], op[3])
        elif op[0] == 'query':
            for a in op[1]: exp.append(fib.lpm(a))
        elif op[0] == 'image_query':
            for a in op[1]: exp.append(None)
        elif op[0] == 'load_saved': loaded = Image(res['snapshots'][op[1]])
    exp2 = []
    for op in ops + [['query', addrs_q], ['image_query', addrs_i]]:
        if op[0] == 'put': fib.put(op[1], op[2], op[3])
        elif op[0] == 'query':
            for a in op[1]: exp2.append(fib.lpm(a))
        elif op[0] == 'image_query':
            for a in op[1]: exp2.append(loaded.lookup(a) if loaded else None)
    bad = [(i, a, b) for i, (a, b) in enumerate(zip(exp2, res['answers'])) if a != b]
    for img in res['snapshots']: Image(img)
    print('%-38s answers=%d snaps=%d loads=%s mismatch=%d' %
          (label, len(res['answers']), len(res['snapshots']), res['loads'], len(bad)))
    if bad: print('   ', bad[:5]); raise SystemExit(1)
    return res

rng = random.Random(4)

# 1. all prefixes inside forest 0 (length <= 16), 4000 of them
pref = set()
for ln in range(0, 17):
    for _ in range(4000 // 17 + 1):
        v = rng.getrandbits(ln) if ln else 0
        pref.add((ln, '%032x' % v))
pref = list(pref)[:4000]
ops = [['put', a, ln, rng.randint(0, 4194302)] for (ln, a) in pref] + [['save'], ['load_saved', 0]]
addrs = ['%032x' % rng.getrandbits(128) for _ in range(200)]
addrs += [a for (_, a) in pref[:100]]
r = check(ops, addrs[:len(addrs)//2], addrs[len(addrs)//2:], 'forest0 only (4000 prefixes)')
img = r['snapshots'][0]
print('   cells', img['cells'], 'rows', sum(len(b) for b in img['banks']), 'root', img['root'])

# 2. maximum fanout at one node: 64 children of the forest-0 root (all 64 chunks)
ops = []
for k in range(64):
    v = k << 122
    ops.append(['put', '%032x' % v, 6, k + 1])
ops += [['save'], ['load_saved', 0]]
r = check(ops, ['%032x' % (k << 122) for k in range(0, 64, 7)], ['%032x' % (k << 122) for k in range(1, 64, 5)],
          'fanout 64 at forest-0 root')
img = r['snapshots'][0]
I = Image(img)
print('   types', dict(collections.Counter(n['type'] for n in I.nodes)), 'cells', img['cells'])

# 3. 63 local prefixes at a single node (NI bitmap full)
ops = []
base = rng.getrandbits(118) << 10
cnt = 0
for l in range(0, 6):
    for v in range(1 << l):
        if cnt >= 63: break
        ln = 118 + l
        val = base | (v << (128 - ln))
        ops.append(['put', '%032x' % val, ln, cnt + 1]); cnt += 1
ops += [['save'], ['load_saved', 0]]
r = check(ops, ['%032x' % (base | (1 << 10))], ['%032x' % base], '63 NI locals at one node')
img = r['snapshots'][0]
I = Image(img)
mx = max(bin(n['pattern']).count('1') for n in I.nodes)
print('   max NI popcount', mx, 'cells', img['cells'])

# 4. odd number of half-size nodes at one stage
ops = [['put', '%032x' % ((k << 122) | 0), 6, k] for k in range(3)]
ops += [['put', '%032x' % 0, 0, 99]]
ops += [['save'], ['load_saved', 0]]
r = check(ops, ['%032x' % (2 << 122)], ['%032x' % (1 << 122)], 'odd half-size node count')

# 5. empty live FIB + load of an image with only a /0
ops = [['put', '%032x' % 0, 0, 7], ['save'], ['put', '%032x' % 0, 0, 8], ['load_saved', 0]]
r = check(ops, ['%032x' % 0], ['%032x' % 0], 'save then overwrite then reload')
print('   answers', r['answers'], 'loads', r['loads'])
print('EDGETEST PASS')
PY
